summary: Admin Moderation & Safety: Backend 16/16 pytest passing — taxonomy of 6 reasons (Spam, Harassment / Bullying, Inappropriate Content, Fake Profile, Scam / Suspicious Behaviour, Other), /api/reports returns friendly Thank-you + report_id, 3-reporters-in-24h auto-restriction triggers (target.restricted=true, restricted_reason='Auto-restricted: 3+ reports in 24h', all open reports flipped to urgent=true, notices auto_hidden and filtered out of GET /api/notices), every /api/admin/* endpoint 403s for non-admins and 200s for maggie, admin_summary returns the reports/support/users counts, /api/admin/reports list is sorted urgent-first then newest and enriched with reporter+target_user (+counts payload), /api/admin/reports/{id} returns report + reporter + target_user + related + target_history, status updates persist, warn → moderation_warning notification + resolves the source report with outcome='warned', suspend(24h) blocks /api/auth/login with 403 and notifies admins with moderation_login_attempt, ban blocks login + restore re-enables it, /api/admin/content/remove on a notice removes it from GET /api/notices, restricted/banned users are 403'd from POST /api/notices, support tickets create successfully and notify admins via support_new. Frontend (390x844 mobile): maggie auto-promoted to admin (login via 'Try a demo account' → Margaret); /admin renders 'Admin' header + Moderation overview tiles (Urgent/New/Reviewing/Resolved/Support open/Restricted with live counts 9/13/2/2/2/1), Reports tab with status chips (All/New/Reviewing/Resolved/Dismissed) and 19 enriched report rows sorted urgent-first, Support tab visible; tapping a report row navigates to /admin/report/[id] which renders REPORTED USER + REASON + ADMIN NOTE + Status (Mark reviewing / Dismiss / Mark resolved) + User actions (Warn user / Suspend 24h / Suspend 7 days / Ban user). Profile screen shows '🛡  Admin tools' button (testID=profile-admin) for maggie. /admin shows 'Please log in.' for unauthenticated users. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: ReportSheet is completely unreachable from notices.tsx — setReportFor is never called, and the kebab → 'Report notice' option calls the LEGACY api.reportNotice('user_report') endpoint via a confirm() dialog, bypassing the 6-reason ReportSheet entirely. Also on web Alert.alert is a no-op so the kebab options menu does nothing visible. Pre-existing react-native-web deprecation warnings (shadow*, textShadow*, pointerEvents) remain.

ui_bugs.issue: showActions() uses RN Alert.alert which is silent on web → kebab does nothing visible in the web preview. Use the existing Modal sheet (actionMenuFor) or a cross-platform action sheet. Reference: /app/frontend/app/notices.tsx:121,133

Selecting 'Report notice' calls onReport() which uses confirm() + the LEGACY api.reportNotice(n.id, user.id, 'user_report') endpoint instead of opening the new ReportSheet. As a result, the 6-reason taxonomy, notes field, friendly Thank-you stage and 'Block this user' option are never shown — directly violating the spec 'tap kebab → Report notice → bottom sheet appears with 6 reasons + notes field'. setReportFor is declared at line 41 but is NEVER called anywhere (ReportSheet at line 283 is dead code). Fix: replace `onPress: () => onReport(n)` with `onPress: () => setReportFor(n)`. Reference: /app/frontend/app/notices.tsx:41,100-105,130,283

integration_issues.issue: The new /api/reports + 6-reason flow is wired up on the backend and ReportSheet is implemented correctly, but it is not reachable from any screen in the app (notices.tsx never calls setReportFor). The whole user-facing report-with-reason flow is therefore non-functional from the UI.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1972 _maybe_auto_restrict counts distinct reporter_ids in a 24h window with $gte on ISO-string created_at — works because ISO-8601 sorts lexicographically and all writes use now_iso() with the same timezone offset. Confirmed by automated test that a 3rd unique reporter flips auto_restricted=true; a 2nd report from the SAME reporter would not trigger it (good).

server.py:1996 sets auto_hidden=True on the target's notices; GET /api/notices (line 1789) already filters `auto_hidden: {$ne: True}` so the auto-hide is honoured. Verified by test_auto_restrict_flow.
server.py:354-369 login() blocks banned (403) + suspended-until-future (403) and notifies admins via _notify_admins(moderation_login_attempt). Expired suspensions are cleared inline — nice touch.
server.py:1807-1810 create_notice 403s when author is restricted OR banned. Verified.

server.py:386 demo_login does NOT check banned/suspended/restricted flags. Today this is fine because the only demo admin is maggie, but if any demo account were ever banned by an admin they could still re-enter via /api/auth/demo-login. Worth adding the same banned/suspended guard for parity.
server.py:2082 sort uses ('urgent', -1) ('created_at', -1) — verified urgent-first then newest by test_admin_reports_list_urgent_first.
notices.tsx ReportSheet integration is broken — see frontend_issues.ui_bugs (CRITICAL). setReportFor is declared but never called.
server.py is ~2.67k lines — long-standing recommendation to split admin/safety/games into separate route modules for maintainability.

rca_of_issue: ReportSheet not reachable from Notices — the kebab options menu in /app/frontend/app/notices.tsx pushes an option whose onPress calls the LEGACY onReport(n) handler (which fires a confirm() then POSTs to the old /api/notices/{id}/report endpoint). The newer setReportFor(n) state setter — which would mount the ReportSheet modal at line 283 — is never invoked. Additionally showActions() uses Alert.alert which is a no-op on react-native-web, so even the legacy path is silently broken on the web preview. Reproduction: 1) demo-login as maggie, 2) open /notices, 3) tap the kebab on any notice authored by another user — nothing appears on web. Even on native, selecting 'Report notice' just shows a generic confirm() dialog and posts to the legacy endpoint, completely bypassing the 6-reason taxonomy and the post-report Block prompt mandated by the spec. Mitigation: (a) in showActions(), call setActionMenuFor(opts) instead of Alert.alert so the kebab works on web, and (b) change the 'Report notice' onPress from `onReport(n)` to `setReportFor(n)` so the ReportSheet renders. Both changes are inside one file (notices.tsx) and one screen — the backend /api/reports flow itself is fully working (verified by pytest).
